notes.title: Global Update (May 2022)
notes.notes:
Hello!

We present to your attention a new update.

We have fixed a number of issues and added a continuation of the story - now you have access to the new location "Neon Jungle".

We wish you all a good game!

notes.title: Game Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, dear players!
The release of the NeuraGun game took place.
NeuraGun is a first-person science fiction puzzle game. The player will have to go through a maze of mysteries that will lead him out of the tangled scientific complex.
